svg.title: When to use an agentic loop and when not to
svg.desc: Two columns. Use a loop when the next step depends on real feedback and done is checkable. Skip it for one-shot, irreversible, or taste-driven work.

text.font-family: 'Noto Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: When a loop is the right tool

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: REACH FOR A LOOP

text.font-family: 'Noto Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Use it

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The next action depends on the last result

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Done can be checked by a script or test

text.font-family: Inter, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mistakes are cheap to undo in git
